guitar.notes: Steve Cropper, the Stax/Booker T. & the M.G.'s session guitarist, played on most Sam & Dave hits including 'Soul Man'; well documented as a Telecaster player, though credited to the duo's act rather than a member of the act itself.

tone.target: tight stax-soul clean crunch with sharp funk bite
tone.profile: tight stax-soul clean crunch with sharp funk bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a boost for attack, followed by a classic Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) paired with a 2x12 cab, emphasizing percussive funk rhythms.
corrections: shift from lead to rhythm bite
